A subsequence of nums having length 1 is considered unbalanced.
Return an integer denoting the minimum possible sum of elements in an unbalanced subsequence of nums.
A subsequence of an array is a new non-empty array that is formed from the original array by deleting some (possibly none) of the elements without disturbing the relative positions of the remaining elements.

Hence, it is an unbalanced subsequence, and its sum is the minimum among the unbalanced subsequences of nums.
The subsequence consisting of indices 1, 2, and 3 is also valid.
It can be shown that it is not possible to get an unbalanced subsequence with a sum less than 3.
